subtitles.en: price of beef continuing to go up. You know, you've had so many close things to choose from.
subtitles.zh: 牛肉价格持续上涨。你知道，有太多接近的东西可供选择。

subtitles.en: Big another protein. S***. And I'd rather take another sandwich or I'd stare.
subtitles.zh: 另一个重要的蛋白质。该死。我宁愿再拿一个三明治，或者我会盯着看。

subtitles.en: That ad is hilarious because it is a total party switcheroo.
subtitles.zh: 那个广告很搞笑，因为完全是党派大反转。

subtitles.en: There was a time when the Republicans were trying to say Democrats wanted to take your beef away with the green new deal.
subtitles.zh: 曾有一段时间，共和党人试图说民主党人想通过绿色新政夺走你的牛肉。

subtitles.en: Beef in the guns. Yes. That's right. And the reactions just to a soy based burger being added to a menu.
subtitles.zh: 牛肉和枪支。是的，没错。而反应只是针对菜单上增加了一个大豆汉堡。

subtitles.en: People thought they would say like how dare you take away my burger. Nobody was taking away the burger.
subtitles.zh: 人们以为他们会说，你怎么敢拿走我的汉堡。没人拿走汉堡。

subtitles.en: They were just adding something. We saw that emotional reaction then.
subtitles.zh: 他们只是增加了一些东西。我们当时看到了那种情绪反应。

subtitles.en: I think what it is is that we Americans associate beef with prosperity.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是因为我们美国人把牛肉与繁荣联系在一起。

subtitles.en: It's that it's because it's expensive.
It's more expensive than any of those other proteins. And so the idea of taking what was this affordable luxury
subtitles.zh: 它比任何其他蛋白质都贵。所以，拿走这种负担得起的奢侈品想法

subtitles.en: and making it unaffordable. Maybe it feels like a front how we see ourselves and our own prosperity or something like that.
subtitles.zh: 让人负担不起。也许这像是一种表象，关乎我们如何看待自己和自身的繁荣之类。

subtitles.en: There was a long time when chicken was considered an element of a chicken in every pot.
subtitles.zh: 很长一段时间里，鸡肉被视为“每锅一只鸡”的象征。

subtitles.en: Exactly. And so we've now achieved the point where people can eat chicken every day, multiple times a day.
subtitles.zh: 没错。现在我们已经到了人们可以每天吃鸡肉、一天吃好几顿的地步。

subtitles.en: It's super affordable. Chicken has been bread and mass produced in a way that it's lost a lot of its flavor.
subtitles.zh: 它超级实惠。鸡肉经过大规模生产，失去了很多风味。

subtitles.en: I'm vegetarian. So I don't eat meat anymore. You're just like, you're like closer.
subtitles.zh: 我是素食者。所以我不再吃肉了。你就像，你更接近了。

clip_research.source_claim: There was a time when the Republicans were trying to say Democrats wanted to take your beef away with the green new deal.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting confirms Republicans accused Democrats of a plot to ban beef and used hamburgers as a symbol against the Green New Deal, while the Green New Deal resolution did not explicitly ban burgers.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip frames the beef attack as a past Republican move, but public reporting shows the hamburger/beef attack was a real and recurring GOP messaging line; the surprise is the reversal in which party is now using the beef issue.

evidence.fact: Speaker says Republicans once claimed Democrats wanted to take beef away via the Green New Deal.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
